_meta.source: Music Architect V7 — Production Guide Rev 1.0

bpm_buckets.character: Four-on-the-floor; quarter-note pulse = 480 ms; dotted-8th delay = 360 ms; classic filter-sweep territory

effect_chain.params: 18 Hz, 12 dB/oct Butterworth — removes sub-sonic DC without touching 60-80 Hz fundamental
Attack +3 dB, Sustain -2 dB, Detection 1 ms — punchy but controlled for continuous 4-on-floor
Ratio 4:1, Thr -12 dBFS, Attack 8 ms, Release 960.0 ms (=2×qn@125BPM), Knee 3 dB, GR 3-4 dB
Drive +2-4 dB, Mix 30%, analog console model, THD 2-4%, pre-compressor
Bell -3 dB @300-400 Hz Q=1.4 (boxy removal); Bell +2 dB @65 Hz Q=1.2 (sub punch)
Ceiling -6.0 dBFS true peak, Lookahead 1 ms
24-30 Hz, 12 dB/oct — preserves sub-bass weight while removing infrasonic content
Bell +2 dB @fundamental Q=1.2; Low-pass 300 Hz keeps energy under Chords 250-500 Hz floor
Ratio 6:1, Thr -20 dBFS, Attack 1-2 ms, Release 240.0 ms (=1/8÷2@125BPM), GR 4-6 dB
Drive +3-5 dB, Mix 40%, transistor model, THD 4-6%, post-EQ
Mono below 120 Hz; width 100% above 120 Hz (mono-compatibility law)
Ceiling -7.0 dBFS true peak, Lookahead 1.5 ms, Release 100 ms
150-200 Hz, 12 dB/oct; filter-sweep-ready HPF for classic house filter sweep
Bell -2 dB @800-1200 Hz Q=1.0 (melody pocket); classic 4-pole LP sweep 300 Hz→2 kHz automation
Ratio 3:1, Thr -18 dBFS, Attack 15 ms, Release 480.0 ms (=qn@125BPM), GR 2-4 dB
Rate 0.5 Hz, Depth 15-25%, Mix 18%, 2-3 voices, Spread 60%
Decay 1.4 s, Pre-delay 30.0 ms (=1/16 frac@125BPM), HPF 300 Hz, LPF 7 kHz, Mix 14%
Drive +2 dB, Mix 20%, tape model, THD 3-5%, post-comp

melody.name: Melody
melody.role: Vocal chop or piano riff — focal voice

effect_chain.params: Shelf +2-3 dB @3 kHz, 6 dB/oct — 2-5 kHz equal-loudness peak sensitivity
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -16 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release 320.0 ms (=half-qn+@125BPM), Knee 6 dB, GR 4-6 dB
Drive +2 dB, Mix 25%, HF roll-off 12 kHz
Time 360.0 ms (dotted-8th@125BPM), Feedback 20-30%, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 5 kHz, ping-pong
Decay 1.2 s, Pre-delay 30.0 ms, HPF 400 Hz, LPF 8 kHz, Mix 12%
+2 dB shelf @10 kHz; Ceiling -5 dBFS true peak

arp.name: Arp
arp.role: Rhythmic subdivision carrier — filtered pluck arp

effect_chain.params: Bell +1.5 dB @4-6 kHz Q=1.2; Bell -3 dB @2.9 kHz Q=4 (melody carve)
Ratio 3:1, Attack 3 ms, Release 120.0 ms (=1/16@125BPM), GR 3-5 dB
Time 120.0 ms (1/16@125BPM) L / 240.0 ms (1/8) R, Feedback 22%, HPF 600 Hz
Decay 0.56 s (≈0.4× Chords RT60), Pre-delay 15.0 ms, HPF 700 Hz, Mix 10%
Width 50-70% above 500 Hz; Ceiling -7 dBFS true peak

pads.name: Pads
pads.role: Warm analog spatial floor / sustain glue

effect_chain.params: HPF 200-250 Hz 12 dB/oct; LPF 8 kHz 12 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB @1-2 kHz Q=0.8 — prevents pad masking Melody presence band
Ratio 2:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 30 ms, Release 1920.0 ms (=4×qn@125BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Rate 0.2-0.4 Hz, Depth 30-50%, Mix 45%, Spread 100%, 3 voices
Ratio 3:1, Thr -24 dBFS, Attack 5 ms, Release 960.0 ms (=2×qn@125BPM), GR 3-4 dB — deep house pump
Decay 3.5 s (longest of all tracks), Pre-delay 60.0 ms, HPF 350 Hz, Mix 30%
Width 60-90% above 200 Hz, Correlation floor +0.2, Output limiter -10 dBFS
Attack +5 dB, Sustain -6 dB — keeps stab brief (<300 ms) for temporal masking
Bell +2 dB @2-3 kHz Q=1.0; Bell -3 dB @480 Hz Q=2.0
Ratio 4:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 2 ms, Release 240.0 ms (=1/8@125BPM), GR 5-8 dB
Decay 0.2-0.4 s, Pre-delay 15.0 ms, HPF 400 Hz, Mix 22%
Haas spread 12 ms side only, Width 120%; Ceiling -6 dBFS

fx.name: FX
fx.role: Filter-sweep riser + vinyl texture / transition marker

effect_chain.params: Resonant filter swept upward for house-build aesthetic; sweep 200 Hz→8 kHz typical
Bell -3 dB where overlapping Melody/Lead, Q=1.5
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -28 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release 960.0 ms (=2×qn@125BPM), GR 3-5 dB
Decay ≥3.5 s (≥Pads RT60), Pre-delay 30.0 ms, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 45%
Width 70-90% (mid-side); wide enveloping character
Ceiling -10 dBFS; LPF 16 kHz 12 dB/oct
300-500 Hz, 12 dB/oct (hats); 200 Hz for congas/claps
Attack +3 dB, Sustain -4 dB — classic house snap on backbeat
Ratio 4:1, Attack 1 ms, Release 120.0 ms (=1/16@125BPM), GR 2-4 dB
Shelf +2 dB @8 kHz, 6 dB/oct; Bell -3 dB @900 Hz Q=1.2
Decay 0.15-0.3 s, Pre-delay 15.0 ms, HPF 800 Hz, Mix 12%
Width 40-60% above 800 Hz, Pan spread ±40-60%; Drive +1.5 dB, Mix 25%

intro.name: Intro
intro.owns: First 16-32 bars, DJ-friendly filtered loop (drum+bass only)

effect_chain.params: Sweeps from 400 Hz→20 Hz over 8 bars (15.36 s at 125 BPM); 12 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB where borrowed tracks overlap, Q=1.0
Ratio 2:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 20 ms, Release 960.0 ms (=2×qn@125BPM), GR 2-3 dB
Decay 3.5 s, Pre-delay 60.0 ms, wet% ramps down as intro progresses
Ceiling -9 dBFS true peak

drum.chain: EQ (HPF 25 Hz) -> Comp (4:1, 5 ms attack) -> Saturation (analog console, 2-4% THD) -> Parallel Comp Return

bass.chain: EQ (mono-below-120 filter, resonance shaping) -> Comp (5:1) -> Saturation (transistor, 4-6% THD)

synth.chain: EQ (filter-sweep-ready HPF) -> Comp (2:1, glue) -> Stereo Widener

master.chain: EQ (gentle) -> Bus Comp (2:1, 20 ms attack, 2-3 dB max GR) -> Saturation (0.5% THD) -> Limiter (True Peak -1.0 dBTP)

parallel_compression.reasoning: 25-35% wet adds density to the 4/4 kick grid without erasing the groove's sidechain pump; medium release (50-80 ms) matches the quarter-note at 125 BPM.

kick.exclusive_claim: 60-80 Hz peak; 909 pitch-drop envelope. No other track boosts here.

bass.exclusive_claim: 80-200 Hz; notched -2 dB at kick f0; low-pass at 300 Hz.

chords.exclusive_claim: 250-500 Hz; sweep-modulated; cut -2 dB at 320 Hz for bass room.

melody.exclusive_claim: 800 Hz-3 kHz priority claim; vocal-chop formant region.

arp.exclusive_claim: 3-6 kHz; -3 dB notch at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Side channel only; mid scooped -2 dB at 1-2 kHz; low-pass 4 kHz.

fx.exclusive_claim: Above 8 kHz; resonant sweep for house-build; never simultaneously with riser.

percussion.exclusive_claim: 6-12 kHz hat zone; congas fill 250-500 Hz with ±18 ms swing.

intro.exclusive_claim: Exists only before first full section; supports 16-bar DJ intro.

streaming.notes: Platform-normalised on ingest. Stem naming: house_gen{N}_seed_{id}_{track}_v{ver}.wav

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 ±0.5 LU tolerance; anything outside is rejected at ingest.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Music editor will re-balance against dialogue; leave dynamic range in.

branches.kick_desc: Pure sine sub kick — deep minimal house variant
Four-on-the-floor analog kick with body — primary house default
Dark slow-attack sub kick — cinematic deep house variant

bass.avoid: A2-A3 (two slow-attack low elements erase transient anchor)

chords.codes: B1-B3, any D, any A, R1-R2
